throughline.zh: 本週台灣製造業與積體電路統計成長，同時晶圓測試、矽光子設備、工業微電網、先進封裝材料與記憶體勞資談判揭露不同執行進度，跨境晶片設計與技術合作則仍待驗證和商用交付。
throughline.en: This week's Taiwan manufacturing and IC output improved, alongside test and photonics equipment plans, a commissioned factory microgrid, packaging materials and labor developments; cross-border chip design partnerships remain subject to product qualification and commercial delivery.

title.zh: 先進封裝、測試與高速互連：設備與材料擴建
title.en: Advanced packaging, testing and interconnect: equipment and materials

summary.zh: 本週公告涵蓋台灣載板、矽電容、光學引擎、測試設備及封裝材料，漢測 10 月 22 日新增 64 億元的研發與探針卡設備製造預算授權。新台幣預算屬董事會核准額，京元電產能預付款及矽品倍數則屬不同計畫，認證和實際出貨尚需分開查證。
summary.en: This week's coverage includes substrates, silicon capacitors, optical engines, test equipment and packaging materials. Hermes Testing authorized NT$6.4B for R&D and probe-card equipment facilities on October 22, while KYEC advances and SPIL multiplier targets are separate plans without published qualified shipment volumes.

title.zh: 晶圓製造與電子需求：外銷訂單、出口及 9 月生產
title.en: Foundry and electronics demand: orders, exports and September output

summary.zh: 台灣 9 月外銷訂單達 1,142.1 億美元，10 月 23 日公布的製造業生產指數年增 20.21%，積體電路業年增 26.51%；馬來西亞 9 月出口亦年增 54.5%。製造業指數低於原預估區間，且外銷訂單、實際生產及用電數字不能直接合計。
summary.en: Taiwan's September orders reached US$114.21B, manufacturing output rose 20.21% and IC output 26.51% in figures released October 23; Malaysia's exports increased 54.5%. Manufacturing missed the previous index range, while orders, production and electricity use remain distinct statistical measures.

title.zh: 記憶體供應：美光桃園協商進度及馬日設計合作
title.en: Memory supply: Micron negotiations and Malaysia-Japan design

summary.zh: 美光台中工會 21 日達成協議，桃園工會幹部 22 日罷工，23 日公布 1,633 名會員反對公司方案，協商延至 27 日。另一方面，馬來西亞 SkyeChip 與日本 SAIMEMORY 公布新型記憶體設計合作，尚無產品量產資料。
summary.en: Micron reached a Taichung union agreement on October 21; Taoyuan union officers struck on October 22, and the union reported 1,633 ballots against Micron's proposal on October 23, moving talks to October 27. Separately, Malaysia's SkyeChip joined SAIMEMORY memory architecture development without production data.

title.zh: 資料中心與晶片系統：台灣 ODM、CPU 合作及新加坡展會
title.en: Data centers and chip systems: Taiwan ODMs, CPUs and Singapore event

summary.zh: 本週涵蓋神雲擴廠、資料中心機房計畫、NVIDIA 模組化機房設計、神盾與法國 SiPearl 的 CPU 晶片合作，以及台灣預定 33 家新創赴新加坡展覽。系統開發合作、設備交付目標及預定投資交流未揭露相同口徑的已交付營運容量。
summary.en: This week's developments span MiTAC expansion, data-center facilities, NVIDIA's modular design, Egis-SiPearl CPU-chiplet cooperation and 33 Taiwanese startups heading to Singapore. Technology agreements, delivery targets and planned investment meetings do not represent comparable live capacity.

title.zh: 工廠擴張條件：工安、電力、設備材料與出口管制
title.en: Factory execution: safety, power, materials and export controls

summary.zh: 台積電高雄工地事故後同類鋼構作業暫停，另有設備稀土替代評估；漢翔 22 日啟用 9MW／54MWh 工業微電網，貿易署同日新增 343 個受管制實體。工廠設備、廠務供電與出口管制各有不同的技術、施工及法定查核條件。
summary.en: Similar steel work was suspended after the TSMC Kaohsiung site accident, with separate reporting on alternative motor materials. AIDC commissioned a 9MW / 54MWh microgrid on October 22, and Taiwan's trade authority added 343 controlled entities, each requiring distinct technical, construction and regulatory interpretation.
